basis: The visual evidence supports r3, which concludes the output trend is a decline based on the endpoint change from 2018 to 2023. The chart title (r2) is refuted because its authority is not supported by the visual data; the plot shows a decline from 2018 to 2019 and from 2021 to 2023, contradicting the title. r1 is not applicable as its condition of 'recent stability' is not supported by the full-period endpoint comparison required by the task scope. The task explicitly requires using the dashboard (plot) as the evidence source, and r3 is the only reading that meets this requirement and is fully supported by the visual data.
